items.title_en: OnlyFans Star Sophie Rain Earns Over Rs 367 Crore A Year. That’s More Than Rs 1 Crore A Day
items.title_zh: OnlyFans 明星 Sophie Rain 年收入超过 36.7 亿卢比。每天超过 1 千万卢比
items.summary_en: OnlyFans Star Sophie Rain, who made more than Rs 367 crore in a year, used a part of her earnings to pay off her parents' debt.
items.summary_zh: OnlyFans 明星索菲·雷恩 (Sophie Rain) 年收入超过 36.7 亿卢比，她用部分收入偿还了父母的债务。
